about: Per question figure (file name in assets/diagrams/): the answer-revealing regions found in a pixel review ('leaks') and the '?' badges that cover them until the question is answered ('masks'). Rects are [x, y, w, h] as fractions of the image. Every figure in diagrams.json must have an entry; every leak must lie inside a mask. See docs/DIAGRAMS_AUDIT.md.

final-exam-1-005.png.note: Meter readings (0 V across S1, 120 V across L1) and the ON position are givens from the stem. The lamp filament is drawn intact, so nothing shows the open lamp.

final-exam-1-013.png.note: Meters are labelled only I, II, III METER (no A/V symbols); the series/parallel wiring is the question itself.

final-exam-1-047.png.note: Symbols carry only the letters (a)-(d); no names.
